zh: 布里斯托大学（University of Bristol）始建于1876年，位于英国英格兰布里斯托市，是英国著名的红砖大学之一，也是罗素大学集团成员。学校在医学、工程、社会科学、法律等领域享有盛誉，其学术研究水平位居世界前列。布里斯托大学以其创新的教学方法和卓越的研究成果著称，培养了众多诺贝尔奖得主和行业领袖。
en: The University of Bristol, founded in 1876, is located in Bristol, England. It is one of the UK's renowned red brick universities and a member of the Russell Group. The university excels in medicine, engineering, social sciences, law, and other fields, with world-leading academic research. Known for its innovative teaching and outstanding research, it has produced numerous Nobel laureates and industry leaders.
